rawProductJson.name: Helix Docking Station Air
rawProductJson.description: The Helix Docking Station Air. A dependable peripherals pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Docking Station, Carry sleeve, USB-C to USB-A cable, Spare switches, Wireless receiver

reviews.author: Farah R.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Helix seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Lakshmi N.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Matches the listing description exactly. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Karthik H.
reviews.title: Expected better
reviews.body: Stopped working properly in the third week. It rattles when handled, which does not inspire confidence. Expected more from Helix. Going with a different brand.

reviews.author: Karthik H.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Second Helix product I own and both have lasted. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Aditi S.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Matches the listing description exactly. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Devansh N.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Helix seem to have got this one right. No regrets.

reviews.author: Sana S.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Matches the listing description exactly. Would buy the same one again.
